query: Our GitHub Actions Go build takes 6 minutes every time even though setup-go restores the cache. Why?
expected_behavior: Suggests recording two CI runs with whyrebuilt record and uploading the records as artifacts
Runs whyrebuilt compare on the two records once they exist
Names the root causes with their A and B values and the setting to change
Mentions the GOCACHE note if every key matches

query: Here are two whyrebuilt records, a.rec.gz from runner one and b.rec.gz from runner two. What should I change?
expected_behavior: Explains the largest cause first, such as a changed checkout path without -trimpath
Doesn't claim a specific time saving

query: whyrebuilt compare exits 2 and says the recorded command failed. Can you just tell me what differs anyway?
expected_behavior: Explains that a failed run can stop early, so its keys can't be compared
Suggests fixing the build, or recording go test -run '^$' when tests fail
Doesn't guess at a result from the failed record
